page.overview:
Who is Sang?

Sang is a fictional character of Malibu Comics that fuses with his twin brother Sing to create Siang, the greatest warrior of the Order of Light. He makes his first appearance as Sang in Mortal Kombat Blood and Thunder #1.

It is said in the comic book that individually Sing and Sang possess exceptional skill and strength, but with their ability to merge into a single body, their abilities double.

As Siang, he tried to defeat Goro but was easily killed by him.
